## init installs lockstep in a repository without overwriting

ID: `lockstep-init/init-installs-lockstep-in-a-repository-without-overwriting`

Status: **implemented and tested**

`lockstep init` SHALL write, for each of these that is absent, `lockstep.yaml` (a `checks:` map setting every commit check to `block` except `maintainability`, `helper-reuse` and `mutation`, which it writes as `off` with a comment saying what each does, `owner`, `sources.human_pattern`, a `planning:` section setting `gate` and `one_page_plans` to `block` with a comment saying what each does, a `guard:` section setting `mode` to `block` with a comment saying what it does, empty `governed` and `layout`), a Claude Code PreToolUse hook in `.claude/settings.json`, a Codex PreToolUse hook in `.codex/hooks.json`, neither setting `PCW_MODE`, and a `lockstep` pre-commit command in `lefthook.yml` (which leaves those three out). It SHALL print one line per file it wrote or skipped, SHALL leave an existing `lockstep.yaml` unchanged, SHALL add its hook to an existing settings or hooks file without removing other keys, and a second run SHALL change nothing.

## init upgrades its own old hook command only where lockstep yaml sets the guard

ID: `lockstep-init/init-upgrades-its-own-old-hook-command-only-where-lockstep-yaml-sets-the-guard`

Status: **implemented and tested**

When a settings or hooks file holds the edit-guard command an earlier `lockstep init` wrote (exactly `PCW_MODE=block uvx --from <source> lockstep-hook`, with its client prefix or suffix), `lockstep init` SHALL rewrite that command to the current one when the repository's `lockstep.yaml` has a `guard:` section, and SHALL otherwise leave it unchanged and print a line saying to add `guard: {mode: block}` to `lockstep.yaml` and run `lockstep init` again. Any other Lockstep hook command SHALL be left unchanged.

## init writes the company planning plugin keys when planning skills is on

ID: `lockstep-init/init-writes-the-company-planning-plugin-keys-when-planning-skills-is-on`

Status: **implemented and tested**

When `planning.skills` in `lockstep.yaml` is `{mode: block|warn, marketplace: OWNER/REPO}`, `lockstep init` SHALL merge into `.claude/settings.json` the marketplace `inside-success` (`extraKnownMarketplaces.inside-success.source` = `{source: github, repo: OWNER/REPO}`) and `enabledPlugins."company-planning@inside-success": true`, keeping every other key, and SHALL print `wrote`, `skipped` (everything already matches) or `conflict` for `planning.skills`. It SHALL never overwrite an `inside-success` entry with another source or repository, nor an `enabledPlugins` value that is not `true` (a `false` is a person opting out); each is named in a `conflict` line and left as it is. Extra fields such as `autoUpdate` SHALL be kept and SHALL NOT count as a difference. A `.claude/settings.json` that is not valid JSON SHALL make init exit 2. With `mode: off` or no `skills` key it SHALL write and remove nothing for this setting. When on, it SHALL print the two Codex commands with the configured address (`codex plugin marketplace add OWNER/REPO`, `codex plugin add company-planning@inside-success`), reading and writing nothing in `~/.codex/`, and the Claude Code project commands: list marketplaces, register the configured `OWNER/REPO` with `--scope project` only when `inside-success` is absent, then run `claude plugin install company-planning@inside-success --scope project`; it SHALL add that line once to an existing, non-symlinked `AGENTS.md` under a `## Company Planning plugin` heading, and otherwise only print it. A `skills` value with an unknown mode or a marketplace that is not `owner/repo` (or missing when on) SHALL make init exit 2 naming the line. A fresh `lockstep.yaml` SHALL hold the key commented out.

## installed files name no machine and read their settings from lockstep yaml

ID: `lockstep-init/installed-files-name-no-machine-and-read-their-settings-from-lockstep-yaml`

Status: **implemented and tested**

Files `lockstep init` writes SHALL contain no absolute path and no `/home/`; the hook commands SHALL install Lockstep from a git address with `uvx`. `--owner` SHALL set `owner:` in `lockstep.yaml`, else the owner of the git `origin` remote, else a placeholder. `--human-pattern` SHALL set `sources.human_pattern`, else the checks' own default. The checks SHALL read their modes, `owner` and `sources.human_pattern` from `lockstep.yaml`, so a file copied from one repository works in another.

## the edit guard logs outside the checkout

ID: `lockstep-init/the-edit-guard-logs-outside-the-checkout`

Status: **implemented and tested**

The edit guard SHALL append its decision log to `hook-<date>.jsonl` in the folder named by `LOCKSTEP_LOG_DIR` when that is set, and otherwise in `${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/lockstep/<repository name>/`, where the repository name is the main checkout's folder name for every worktree of it; `lockstep-hook --would-block` SHALL count records there and in the project's older `.lockstep/` and `.pcw/` folders.
